The Chinese characters for Elijah

As a transliteration, Elijah is usually written 以利亚 (Yǐ lì yà). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

以
Yǐ
by means of, with
利
lì
sharp, benefit
亚
yà
Asia, second

Origin and meaning

From Hebrew, Elijah carries the meaning “my God is Yahweh”.

About the name Elijah

The biblical prophet Elijah called down fire from heaven on Mount Carmel.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Elijah carries the meaning “my God is Yahweh” and looks striking in brush strokes.
